services.promoText: Here you can request a free consultation and also see a guide on the steps to follow when developing a brand or product.

process.title: Our Process
process.description: Discover the key steps we follow to take your project from the initial idea to a solid brand identity and a striking web presence.

steps.label: Starting the journey
steps.content: You tell us about your brand, goals, audience, and any special requirements. We align the project vision from the start and gather the key details for planning.

steps.label: Research and Analysis
steps.content: We analyze your competitors, market, and design trends that can benefit your business, along with the best practices and tools for the project.

steps.label: Creative Proposal
steps.content: We present sketches and wireframes for the site plus a visual identity proposal, focused on brand, content, and user experience.

steps.label: Development and Design
steps.content: We build your site with front-end and back-end best practices—WordPress or Astro.js depending on what fits best—and integrate every feature.

steps.label: Testing and Review
steps.content: We test across devices and browsers, walk you through the site for feedback and adjustments, and optimize SEO and analytics.

steps.label: Launch and Final Delivery
steps.content: We deploy to the server, configure the domain, and verify everything works. Your site is ready for traffic, with post-launch support for any tweaks.
